pages.main_text: Our Mission We power fan experiences. Our mission is to understand, inform, entertain, and celebrate fans by building the best entertainment and gaming communities, content, services, and experiences. FANDOM’S FOUNDATIONS Founded in 2004 by Jimmy Wales (yes, the Wikipedia guy) and Angela Beesley Starling (a British web entrepreneur), Fandom (originally Wikicities, and later Wikia) was a new platform that built off the core technology powering Wikipedia in order to super serve the needs of an incredibly passionate set of customers: fans! Fans couldn't dive deep into the lore or world of their favorite TV show, movie or game. For example, fans who visited the Luke Skywalker page on Wikipedia would only learn about Mark Hamill. They wanted a place where they could learn more about Luke, the character, as if he were a real person (and dig into the rest of the Star Wars Universe while they were at it). If Wikipedia is the "encyclopedia", then Fandom is the rest of the library - a deep repository of information about every fictional universe. Speaking of Star Wars, one of our earliest wikis was Wookieepedia . By 2007, Wookieepedia was home to over 50,000 articles. It was so complex and authoritative that the Star Wars creative team themselves began using it as a resource for their projects. Today, hundreds of thousands of articles on Wookieepedia make up one of the most trafficked fan communities on the internet. Now imagine that kind of depth of information across every fictional universe... ever, and you're starting to get a handle on Fandom! Of course, fans want to do much more than just learn about their favorite fictional worlds. They want to play, connect, create, shop and celebrate. Over time, Fandom has added new services that help fans get into what they love in new ways: GameSpot and TV Guide help fans navigate the ever expanding entertainment and gaming universe. The ScreenJunkies channel connects fans to the honest, and sometimes hilarious world of fan conversations. Metacritic , Bingebot and Fanatical help fans find new favorites in TV and games that they didn't even know they were looking for. Fandom started out with about 1,500 pages from a core group of enthusiastic fan contributors. Over 15 years later, Fandom encompasses over 40 million content pages in over 80 languages on 250,000 wikis about every fictional universe ever created. Fandom is where fans find themselves through entertainment. We provide a brand safe and judgement-free zone where people can discover new favorites, go as deep as they want to and engage with other fans. And we can do it across virtually any entertainment or gaming property out there. OUR FEARLESS LEADERS! Fandom's leadership team is dedicated to serving fans of all types. The team works together to ensure the company remains a place that celebrates individuality and passion. Jay Sullivan Chief Executive Officer Ed Lu Chief Operating Officer & Chief Financial Officer Jeremy Steinberg Chief Revenue Officer Regine Weiner SVP, Community and Commerce Peter Mansour Chief Product Officer Kerri Corley Chief People Officer Des Cussen General Counsel FOLLOW US X Instagram Facebook LinkedIn

pages.main_text: Careers Powered By Passion There are more than 350 million reasons to work at Fandom—the fans that we serve every day. At Fandom, you'll work to help people find new ways to celebrate their passions. You could be helping to build a new community around the latest hit show, writing articles or shooting videos that help fans learn how to beat their favorite video game, or connecting advertisers with one of the biggest and most unique fan communities on the web. And you'll do it all at a company that lets you be you. Because you're awesome. (We're big fans!) Find Your Opportunity View Open Jobs → The #1 resource for fans worldwide 0 M Fans per Month 0 K Fan Communities 0 M+ Pages of Unique Content BE A PART OF A GLOBAL COMPANY "I FOUND MYSELF AT FANDOM" Don't just take it from us - hear it from our biggest fans, and employees. Tiffany Tse Manager, Video Operations "Working here has been such a refreshing experience. All those that you collaborate and work with, respect and have genuine interest for each other to succeed. Not only that, but you can be your authentic self. Whether you think you have a weird interest or hobby, you are VERY likely to find at least one other if not a group of those with the same interest here." Houssam Yahiaoui Manager, Software Engineering "I'm a member of our UX Engineering Team and at Fandom, I'm working with committed and creative people all over the world! I get to empower fans to engage with their favourite Fandoms and the content they love." Emin Bassavand Senior Manager, Post Production "I love the culture here. What makes me most interested in Fandom is that you get people from all walks of life with all kinds of experiences, and each is crucial to the shared goal. I have total respect for my colleagues- everyone here is the best at what they do." Daniel (Grunny) Grunwell Vice President, Software Engineering "As a Star Wars fan, I was drawn to Fandom's Star Wars wiki, first as an editor, then an admin. Once I got my PhD in Information Security I joined Fandom's Engineering team. I am a huge user of our products and get joy out of working on the obsessions that I love. I get to work with great people all over the world, have had a tremendous amount of growth, and get to work on things that excite me." Sannse Cushway Director, Community Support "I've been at Fandom since almost the beginning. We were a new and small company when I joined. But we grew quickly and now I'm delighted by what Fandom has become! I love that we have so many experts in so many roles, it's an absolute pleasure to work with them. My own role has changed over the years, but I've always felt supported and appreciated by those around me. I'm excited to see what's next!" Wiktoria Borowiecka Lead Ad Ops Specialist "Fandom is a great place to work. I get to work with and learn from a diverse group of people across a bunch of different teams, who are all warm, engaging, and open. I get to work on amazing campaigns in partnership with the top entertainment companies. It's really fun!" Our Values Connection with our fans, creators, and partners is at our core, all grounded in inclusivity We imagine, improve, and deliver solutions We celebrate our fandoms, our teammates, and the work we do You'll Be a Fan of Our Benefits We are passionate about enabling our people to be at their best at work and at play.
